THRESHOLD_GOODS_SERVICES.description: Procurement regulation threshold for goods and services; published on the Procurement intranet page, not printed in this PDF
THRESHOLD_GOODS_SERVICES.verbatim_quote: There are three different procurement regulation thresholds for: [...] 2. Goods and Services; and [...] The latest values are published on the Procurement intranet page

THRESHOLD_WORKS_CONCESSIONS.description: Procurement regulation threshold for works and concession contracts; published on the Procurement intranet page, not printed in this PDF
THRESHOLD_WORKS_CONCESSIONS.verbatim_quote: There are three different procurement regulation thresholds for: [...] 1. Works and concession contracts;

THRESHOLD_LIGHT_TOUCH.description: Procurement regulation threshold for light touch contracts; published on the Procurement intranet page, not printed in this PDF
THRESHOLD_LIGHT_TOUCH.verbatim_quote: There are three different procurement regulation thresholds for: [...] 3. Light Touch Contracts.

THRESHOLD_RELEVANT.description: Whichever of the three thresholds applies to the contract type; used where a clause says only 'the Threshold' or 'the relevant Threshold' for all contract types
THRESHOLD_RELEVANT.verbatim_quote: “Threshold” refers to the relevant financial thresholds relating to Goods & Services, Works, Concession contracts and Light Touch contracts as set out in the applicable Procurement Legislation and published on the Procurement Intranet page

rules.condition: service contract with estimated value above the goods & services Threshold

threshold_low.as_printed: exceeds the Threshold for Goods & Services

rules.required_action: consider how the procurement or contract might improve economic, social and environmental wellbeing (Social Value Act 2012 and Social Value Policy)
rules.evidence_source: procurement file / tender documents showing social value consideration
rules.verbatim_quote: When proposing to procure or make arrangements for procuring a service contract where the estimated value exceeds the Threshold for Goods & Services, consideration must be given as to how the procurement or contract might improve the economic, social and environmental wellbeing of West Berkshire

rules.condition: any contract
rules.required_action: contract must rest on a decision of the Council, the Executive, or a decision-maker within the Scheme of Delegation
rules.approver: the Council; the Executive; or within the Scheme of Delegation an Executive Decision Maker, a Council Committee or Sub-Committee, or an officer or their delegate
rules.evidence_source: decision record (Council/Executive minute, delegated decision record)
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts must be in accordance with a decision:

rules.condition: any contract
rules.required_action: contract entered into only against an existing provision in the Council-approved Budget
rules.evidence_source: budget code / cost centre on the purchase order checked to the approved budget
rules.verbatim_quote: No contract shall be entered into unless it is in accordance with an existing budgetary provision within the Budget approved by the Council.

rules.condition: contract award value above £500,000
rules.required_action: treat the award as a Key Decision
rules.approver: Key Decision of the Council
rules.evidence_source: Forward Plan entry and Key Decision record
rules.verbatim_quote: Any contract award with a value over £500,000 is a Key Decision of the Council.

rules.condition: Service Director lacks delegated authority for the contract
rules.required_action: obtain approval in accordance with Appendix A before award
rules.approver: as set out in Appendix A
rules.evidence_source: approval record dated before the award
rules.verbatim_quote: Where a Service Director does not have delegated authority to enter into a contract, approval in accordance with Appendix A is required before the contract can be awarded.

rules.condition: expenditure above £500
rules.required_action: publish the expenditure (Transparency Code 2015)
rules.evidence_source: published 'Expenditure over £500' data reconciled to the ledger
rules.verbatim_quote: Expenditure exceeding £500, including payments to suppliers and contractors.

rules.condition: invitation to tender for goods and/or services with value above £5,000
rules.required_action: publish details of the invitation to tender
rules.evidence_source: council transparency publications / Procurement Portal
rules.verbatim_quote: Details of every invitation to tender for contracts to provide goods and/or services with a value that exceeds £5,000.

rules.condition: contracts in progress and awarded
rules.required_action: publish a register of contracts with value, duration and supplier
rules.evidence_source: published contract register
rules.verbatim_quote: A register of contracts, including those in progress and those awarded, with key information such as the contract value, duration and supplier.

rules.condition: all service areas
rules.required_action: report contract information to the relevant board monthly
rules.evidence_source: monthly contract reports to the relevant board
rules.verbatim_quote: Service areas are therefore responsible for reporting contract information to the relevant board on a monthly basis in a format as required by Procurement Legislation.

rules.condition: any contract award
rules.required_action: check suppliers meet minimum standards of suitability, capability, legal status and financial standing
rules.evidence_source: supplier selection / due-diligence checks on the procurement file
rules.verbatim_quote: Officers undertaking procurement are responsible for ensuring that all persons awarded contracts for the supplies, services or works to the Council meet the Council's minimum standards of suitability, capability, legal status and financial standing.

rules.condition: contract opportunity being advertised
rules.required_action: advertise electronically on the Council's Procurement Portal so it also appears on the CDP
rules.approver: relevant Service Director
rules.evidence_source: Procurement Portal advert and matching CDP notice
rules.verbatim_quote: All contract opportunities being advertised by the relevant Service Director should be done so electronically on the Council's Procurement Portal to ensure that such opportunities also appear on the Central Digital Platform (CDP) database.

rules.condition: opportunity above the relevant Procurement Legislation threshold (not a framework further competition)

threshold_low.as_printed: above the relevant Procurement Legislation thresholds

rules.required_action: advertise on the CDP before any other advertising medium
rules.evidence_source: CDP notice date compared with other advert dates
rules.verbatim_quote: All contract opportunities which are above the relevant Procurement Legislation thresholds must be advertised on the CDP database (a web-based portal provided by the Cabinet Office) prior to such advertisement appearing on any other advertising medium

rules.condition: any CDP notice
rules.required_action: CDP notice approved and issued by the procurement lead
rules.approver: Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate
rules.evidence_source: CDP notice publisher / approval record
rules.verbatim_quote: CDP notices must be approved and issued by the Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate as appropriate

rules.condition: estimating any contract's value
rules.required_action: estimate Total Contract Value over the full potential duration, including all extensions, options and VAT
rules.evidence_source: contract value estimate on the procurement file / award report
rules.verbatim_quote: Total Contract Value is a genuine estimate of the total value over the full potential duration of the contract, not just the initial term. This includes: [...] All planned extensions (even if optional) [...] Value Added Tax

rules.condition: any requirement
rules.required_action: do not split or disaggregate a contract to avoid the Procurement Legislation or these Rules
rules.evidence_source: spend data: repeated payments to one supplier for similar requirements; purchase orders
rules.verbatim_quote: There shall be no artificial splitting or disaggregation of a contract to avoid the application of the provisions of the Procurement Legislation and/or these Rules.

rules.condition: repeat purchases or purchases of a similar type in a period, each initially below the Threshold
rules.required_action: seek advice on whether the Procurement Legislation applies to the aggregated purchases
rules.evidence_source: record of procurement advice; spend data for repeat purchases from one supplier
rules.verbatim_quote: The Procurement Legislation can cover contracts which are initially below the stated relevant Threshold where they constitute repeat purchases and/or purchases of a similar type in a specified period. Officers responsible for such procurement should therefore seek advice on the application of the Procurement Legislation where they envisage that they may be required to make such purchases.

rules.condition: contract with estimated value above the appropriate Threshold
rules.required_action: issue an electronic Invitation to Tender; tenders submitted via the Procurement Portal
rules.evidence_source: Procurement Portal tender record
rules.verbatim_quote: An electronic Invitation to Tender shall be issued by the Council for all contracts with an estimated value that is more than the appropriate Threshold and tenders shall be submitted electronically by tenderers via the Council's Procurement Portal.

rules.condition: electronic tender submitted
rules.required_action: store tenders in a secure portal account locked until the specified opening date and time
rules.evidence_source: Procurement Portal audit log (lock and opening times)
rules.verbatim_quote: such tenders shall be stored in a secure portal account which is locked until the date and time specified for its opening.

rules.condition: tender received after the specified opening time
rules.required_action: reject late tender unless exceptional circumstances are accepted and other tenders are unopened
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer
rules.evidence_source: Portal receipt timestamps; Monitoring Officer decision record for any late tender accepted
rules.verbatim_quote: No tender received after the time and date specified for its opening shall be accepted or considered by the Council unless the Monitoring Officer is satisfied that there are exceptional circumstances and the other tenders have not been opened.

rules.condition: opening of electronic tenders
rules.required_action: tenders opened by a Procurement Officer with an audit record kept on the e-tendering system
rules.evidence_source: e-tendering system opening audit record
rules.verbatim_quote: The electronic opening of tenders submitted on the Procurement Portal shall be conducted by a Procurement Officer with an audit record being maintained on the e-tendering system.

rules.condition: evaluation of any quote or tender
rules.required_action: evaluate against criteria notified in advance to bidders
rules.evidence_source: RFQ/ITT documents stating criteria; evaluation records
rules.verbatim_quote: All quotes and tenders shall be evaluated in accordance with evaluation criteria notified in advance to those submitting quotes/tenders.

rules.condition: any contract award
rules.required_action: award on most advantageous / best value basis having regard to the Social Value Policy, not lowest price alone, unless an exception is approved in advance
rules.approver: relevant Service Director (for exceptions, in advance)
rules.evidence_source: award report / evaluation scoring; prior approval of any exception
rules.verbatim_quote: Save in exceptional circumstances approved in advance by the relevant Service Director all contracts shall be awarded on the basis of the quote or tender which is most advantageous and represents best value for money to the Council having regard to the provisions of the Social Value Policy, and not only on the basis of lowest price.

rules.condition: contract above £24,999.99 where competition is to be waived
rules.required_action: waiver only in the 7.2.1 (urgency, outside Procurement Legislation) or 7.2.2 circumstances, subject to 7.4
rules.evidence_source: exception/waiver register and supporting report
rules.verbatim_quote: Subject to 7.4 the requirement for the Council to conduct a competitive purchasing process, contracts with a value of more than £24,999.99, may be excepted or waived in the following circumstance:

rules.condition: waiver at Executive Director / Chief Executive discretion
rules.required_action: record reasons for the waiver in writing
rules.approver: relevant Executive Director and/or the Chief Executive
rules.evidence_source: written reasons on the waiver record
rules.verbatim_quote: at the discretion of the relevant Executive Director and/or the Chief Executive, acting lawfully, who may proceed in a manner most expedient for the efficient management of the Council with reasons recorded in writing.

rules.condition: any waiver or exception to the Rules
rules.required_action: waiver granted only by the named officers, sought in advance and only in exceptional circumstances
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer and/or the S.151 Officer
rules.evidence_source: waiver approval dated before the purchase
rules.verbatim_quote: Only the Monitoring Officer and/or the S.151 Officer may grant a waiver or an exception to these Rules, subject to exception values and delegation thresholds detailed in these Rules and/or elsewhere in the Constitution. An officer who seeks a waiver of these Rules shall do so only in advance and only in exceptional circumstances.

rules.condition: exception for a contract up to the Threshold
rules.required_action: S.151 Officer approves the exception
rules.approver: S.151 Officer
rules.evidence_source: S.151 approval on the exception record
rules.verbatim_quote: for all contracts up to the Threshold, the S.151 Officer must approve the exception;

rules.condition: exception for a contract above the relevant Threshold and up to £500,000
rules.required_action: S.151 Officer consults Monitoring Officer and Executive Director; exception report approved by the relevant board (retrospective only for urgency)
rules.approver: S.151 Officer with Monitoring Officer and appropriate Executive Director; relevant board
rules.evidence_source: exception report and board approval
rules.verbatim_quote: for contracts above the relevant Threshold and up to £500,000, the S.151 Officer will consult with the Monitoring Officer and the appropriate Executive Director provided and an exception report has been approved by the relevant board

rules.condition: exception for a contract over £500,000
rules.required_action: S.151 Officer and Monitoring Officer recommend to the Executive; exception report approved by the relevant board and Corporate Board
rules.approver: Executive (on recommendation of S.151 Officer and Monitoring Officer)
rules.evidence_source: Executive decision; exception report; board and Corporate Board approvals
rules.verbatim_quote: for contracts over £500,000 the S.151 Officer and the Monitoring Officer will make a recommendation to the Executive provided an exception report has been prepared and approved by the relevant board and Corporate Board.

rules.condition: any exception or waiver
rules.required_action: fully document the exception or waiver
rules.evidence_source: exception/waiver file
rules.verbatim_quote: All exceptions or waivers to these Rules must: [...] be fully documented;

rules.condition: waiver where competition is not excluded by the Procurement Legislation
rules.required_action: submit a written exception report with reasons to the relevant board in advance
rules.approver: relevant board (report by Service Director / Head of Service or Executive Director)
rules.evidence_source: exception report and board papers dated before the purchase
rules.verbatim_quote: for any contract where the requirement to hold a competitive process is not excluded by the Procurement Legislation, be subject to a written exception report to be submitted in advance to the relevant board by the relevant Service Director / Head of Service, Service Director or Executive Director

rules.condition: any exception or waiver
rules.required_action: S.151 Officer approves and records that the circumstances are genuinely exceptional
rules.approver: S.151 Officer
rules.evidence_source: S.151 Officer's recorded consideration on the waiver
rules.verbatim_quote: be subject to approval by the S.151 Officer who shall record they have considered the reasons for the waiver and that they are satisfied that the circumstances justifying the waiver are genuinely exceptional

rules.condition: use of a Purchasing Scheme (framework, DPS, dynamic market, consortium, etc.)
rules.required_action: seek advice confirming legal entitlement, coverage of the purchase and compliance of the scheme
rules.evidence_source: record of procurement/legal advice before call-off
rules.verbatim_quote: An officer responsible for a procurement exercise may use a Purchasing Scheme provided that they have sought advice to confirm that:

rules.condition: contract awarded above the Threshold and subject to the Procurement Legislation
rules.required_action: produce a written procurement report documenting key decisions and stages
rules.approver: relevant Service Director (author)
rules.evidence_source: procurement report on the contract file
rules.verbatim_quote: A written report in accordance with the Procurement Legislation shall be produced by the relevant Service Director for each contract that is awarded which is above the Threshold and subject to the Procurement Legislation

rules.condition: 9.1 procurement report
rules.required_action: keep the report for three years
rules.evidence_source: retained report on file
rules.verbatim_quote: This report may be requested by the Cabinet Office and shall be kept for three years.

rules.condition: any procurement, regardless of value
rules.required_action: document the progress of the procedure, with enough information to justify decisions
rules.approver: relevant Service Director
rules.evidence_source: procurement file (communications, evaluation, award)
rules.verbatim_quote: the relevant Service Director should document the progress of all procurement procedures (regardless of value)

rules.condition: any procurement, regardless of value
rules.required_action: keep procurement documentation for three years from award
rules.evidence_source: retained procurement file
rules.verbatim_quote: Such documentation must be kept for three years from the award of the contract.

rules.condition: any purchase
rules.required_action: hold written (including electronic) evidence of the purchase
rules.evidence_source: purchase order / contract / email confirmation behind each payment
rules.verbatim_quote: There should be written evidence of all purchases (which shall include electronic evidence).

rules.condition: contracts 'as detailed in Appendix B'
rules.required_action: contract in writing, in a form approved by the Monitoring Officer
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer
rules.evidence_source: signed written contract on file
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts entered into by the Council as detailed in Appendix B must be in writing in a form approved by the Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer.

rules.condition: contract sealed on behalf of the Council
rules.required_action: Legal Services retains the sealed contract documents
rules.evidence_source: Legal Services contract store
rules.verbatim_quote: Legal Services shall retain all contract documents that are sealed on behalf of the Council.

rules.condition: award of any contract
rules.required_action: notify the procurement lead so the contract is recorded on the Council Contract Register
rules.approver: relevant Service Director (notifies)
rules.evidence_source: Council Contract Register entry for the contract
rules.verbatim_quote: The relevant Service Director must formally notify the Service Lead for Commissioning and Procurement (or nominated officer) of the award of all contracts for the purpose of it being recorded on the Council Contract Register.

rules.condition: any contract
rules.required_action: include the standard clauses from the relevant Standard Form of Agreement
rules.evidence_source: contract document compared with the Standard Form of Agreement
rules.verbatim_quote: Every contract shall include the standard clauses set out in the relevant Standard Form of Agreement issued and updated from time to time by the Monitoring Officer or their nominated officer and available from Legal Services.

rules.condition: Standard Form of Agreement amended
rules.required_action: amended form approved by the Monitoring Officer
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer
rules.evidence_source: Legal approval of the amended contract form
rules.verbatim_quote: Where a Standard Form of Agreement is to be amended, the form of contract shall be prepared/amended by the relevant Service Director for approval by the Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer.

rules.condition: any contract, where appropriate
rules.required_action: include the minimum clauses listed in 10.7.1-10.7.10 (scope, time, quality, insurance, default, legislation, data, cancellation/bribery, payment, specification)
rules.evidence_source: contract document checked against the 10.7 list
rules.verbatim_quote: As a minimum, where appropriate, all contracts shall include clauses setting out:

rules.condition: any contract
rules.required_action: complete a Data Protection Impact Assessment
rules.approver: Service Directors (ensure)
rules.evidence_source: DPIA on the contract file
rules.verbatim_quote: Service Directors must ensure that a Data Protection Impact Assessment is completed for all contracts to inform such clauses.

rules.condition: payment terms in any contract
rules.required_action: contract requires payment within 30 days of a valid, undisputed invoice
rules.evidence_source: contract payment clause; invoice and payment dates
rules.verbatim_quote: any payment due from the Council is made no later than 30 days from the date on which the relevant invoice is regarded as valid and undisputed

rules.condition: any relaxation of full indemnities
rules.required_action: written authorisation before indemnities are relaxed
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer and the S.151 Officer or their nominated officers
rules.evidence_source: written authorisation on the contract file
rules.verbatim_quote: No relaxation of full indemnities releasing the Council from all liability whether provided by public liability insurance or other instrument shall be allowed unless authorised in writing by the Monitoring Officer and the S.151 Officer or their nominated officers.

rules.condition: works contract (or time-critical supplies/services) estimated above £500,000
rules.required_action: consider requiring a performance bond of at least 10% of contract value
rules.approver: relevant Service Director
rules.evidence_source: bond on file, or 11.4 risk assessment
rules.verbatim_quote: Where a contract is estimated to exceed £500,000, in value or amount and is for the execution of works (or for the supplies or services by a particular date or series of dates) the relevant Service Director should consider requiring a performance bond (for an amount equal to at least 10% of the value of the contract)

rules.condition: performance bond required
rules.required_action: bond in a Legal-approved form and included in the Invitation to Tender
rules.approver: Legal Services
rules.evidence_source: ITT documents and bond
rules.verbatim_quote: The bond must be in a form approved by Legal Services and must be included in the Invitation to Tender.

rules.condition: performance bond judged unnecessary
rules.required_action: written risk assessment, approval, and a copy kept on the contract file
rules.approver: Service Director for Finance and Property
rules.evidence_source: risk assessment and approval on the contract file
rules.verbatim_quote: If a performance bond is not considered to be necessary, the relevant Service Director must: [...] undertake a risk assessment in writing; and [...] seek approval from the Service Director for Finance and Property; and

rules.condition: any contract
rules.required_action: assess risk; where insurance is needed, set and check cover in consultation with Finance and Property
rules.approver: Service Director, with the Service Director for Finance and Property
rules.evidence_source: risk assessment; contractor insurance certificates
rules.verbatim_quote: Every contract should be assessed for risk. If the risk assessment identifies the need for insurance the Service Director must:

rules.condition: document to be sealed
rules.required_action: seal only documents approved by resolution or by an officer with delegated powers
rules.approver: Council, Executive or appropriate Committee resolution, or officer with delegated powers
rules.evidence_source: sealing register entry linked to the approving decision
rules.verbatim_quote: The Seal may be affixed, physically or electronically, to any document or proposal that has been approved by a resolution of the Council or Executive, or of an appropriate Committee, or by an officer with delegated powers.

rules.condition: affixing of the Seal
rules.required_action: sealing attested and witnessed in writing
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or an officer duly designated by them
rules.evidence_source: attestation on the sealed document
rules.verbatim_quote: The affixing of the Seal shall be attested and witnessed in writing by the Monitoring Officer or an officer duly designated by them

rules.condition: every sealing
rules.required_action: record the sealing as a consecutively numbered, signed entry in the sealing register
rules.evidence_source: sealing register
rules.verbatim_quote: An entry of every sealing of a document shall be made and consecutively numbered in a book or electronic record to be provided for the purpose

rules.condition: goods, services, works or concession contract above the Threshold
rules.required_action: contract sealed
rules.evidence_source: sealed contract and sealing register entry
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts whether for goods, services, works or concession contracts the value of which is above Threshold shall be sealed.

rules.condition: document executed on the Council's behalf that need not be sealed
rules.required_action: signed by the Monitoring Officer or designated officer; entered in a register
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or an officer designated by them
rules.evidence_source: signatory on the contract; register of signed documents
rules.verbatim_quote: Where it becomes necessary to execute any document on behalf of the Council not required by law to be under seal, the Monitoring Officer or an officer designated by them in accordance with the delegated powers conferred by the Council shall be deemed to have authority to sign such a document accordingly. A register of such documents shall be kept by the Monitoring Officer or officer duly designated by them.

rules.condition: total contract value up to the relevant Threshold
rules.required_action: award under Service Director delegated authority
rules.approver: Relevant Service Director (or officers nominated by them in writing)
rules.evidence_source: award decision signed by the Service Director or written nominee
rules.verbatim_quote: up to relevant Threshold [...] Relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by the Service Director in writing) shall have delegated authority to award the contract.

rules.condition: total contract value above the relevant threshold and below £500,000
rules.required_action: award by Service Director on S151 and Monitoring Officer recommendation, with a written report approved by the relevant board
rules.approver: Relevant Service Director (following recommendation of the S151 officer and Monitoring Officer); relevant board
rules.evidence_source: award report and board approval
rules.verbatim_quote: Above the relevant threshold and less than £500,000 [...] Relevant Service Director (following recommendation of the S151 officer and Monitoring Officer) shall have delegated authority to award the contract provided a written report by the relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by them in writing) has been provided and approved by the relevant board.

rules.condition: total contract value above £500,000 and below £2.5m
rules.required_action: Key Decision by Service Director with Portfolio Holder, on recommendation; written report approved by the relevant board; Call-In and Forward Plan followed
rules.approver: relevant Service Director in consultation with the relevant Portfolio Holder (on recommendation of Executive Director, S151 officer and Monitoring Officer)
rules.evidence_source: Key Decision record, Forward Plan entry, board approval
rules.verbatim_quote: Above £500,000 and less than £2.5million [...] The award of these contracts shall be a Key Decision delegated to the relevant Service Director in consultation with the relevant Portfolio Holder (following recommendation by the relevant Executive Director, S151 officer and Monitoring Officer) to award the contract provided:

rules.condition: total contract value £2.5m or more
rules.required_action: Executive approval (may delegate award via quarterly reports)
rules.approver: Executive
rules.evidence_source: Executive decision / quarterly procurement report
rules.verbatim_quote: £2.5million or more [...] Contracts with a value in excess of £2.5million shall require Executive approval

rules.condition: total value excl. VAT above £1,000 and below £25,000
rules.required_action: seek at least one quote from an appropriate source (no advertising mandated)
rules.evidence_source: quote on the purchase file
rules.verbatim_quote: Above £1,000 and less than £25,000 [...] At least one quote must be sought from an appropriate source.

rules.condition: goods/services, total value excl. VAT from £25,000 to below the goods & services Threshold
rules.required_action: invite quotes via the Procurement Portal from at least three appropriate sources, incl. one SME/VCSE and one local supplier where appropriate and possible
rules.evidence_source: Procurement Portal RFQ record showing the invitees
rules.verbatim_quote: Goods and Services: £25,000 or more and less than the Threshold [...] Invitations to quote must be sent via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME* or VCSE* organisation and one local supplier ****(where appropriate and possible**).

rules.condition: goods/services, total value excl. VAT from £25,000 to below the goods & services Threshold
rules.required_action: publish a contract notice on the CDP
rules.evidence_source: CDP / Contracts Finder notice
rules.verbatim_quote: Goods and Services: £25,000 or more and less than the Threshold [...] A contract notice must be published on the CDP

rules.condition: works, concession or light touch contract, total value excl. VAT from £25,000 to below £500,000
rules.required_action: invite quotes via the Procurement Portal from at least three appropriate sources, incl. one SME/VCSE and one local supplier where appropriate and possible
rules.evidence_source: Procurement Portal RFQ record showing the invitees
rules.verbatim_quote: Works, Concession contracts and Light Touch contracts: £25,000 or more and less than £500,000 [...] Invitations to quote must be sent via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources

rules.condition: works, concession or light touch contract, total value excl. VAT from £25,000 to below £500,000
rules.required_action: publish a contract notice on the CDP
rules.evidence_source: CDP / Contracts Finder notice
rules.verbatim_quote: Works, Concession contracts and Light Touch contracts: £25,000 or more and less than £500,000 [...] A contract notice must be published on the CDP

rules.condition: works or concession contract, total value excl. VAT above £500,000 and below the works & concessions Threshold
rules.required_action: full competitive tender; seek at least five written tenders via the Procurement Portal
rules.evidence_source: Procurement Portal tender record (number of tenders sought)
rules.verbatim_quote: Works, Concession contracts and Light Touch contracts: Above £500,000 and less than the Threshold [...] Full competitive tender process applies and at least five written tenders must be sought via the Procurement Portal.

rules.condition: light touch contract, total value excl. VAT above £500,000 and below the light touch Threshold
rules.required_action: full competitive tender; seek at least five written tenders via the Procurement Portal
rules.evidence_source: Procurement Portal tender record (number of tenders sought)
rules.verbatim_quote: Works, Concession contracts and Light Touch contracts: Above £500,000 and less than the Threshold [...] Full competitive tender process applies and at least five written tenders must be sought via the Procurement Portal.

rules.condition: works or concession contract, total value excl. VAT above £500,000 and below the works & concessions Threshold
rules.required_action: advertise on the Portal with information on the CDP
rules.evidence_source: Procurement Portal advert and CDP notice
rules.verbatim_quote: Above £500,000 and less than the Threshold [...] An advert should be placed on the Portal together with information on the CDP

rules.condition: light touch contract, total value excl. VAT above £500,000 and below the light touch Threshold
rules.required_action: advertise on the Portal with information on the CDP
rules.evidence_source: Procurement Portal advert and CDP notice
rules.verbatim_quote: Above £500,000 and less than the Threshold [...] An advert should be placed on the Portal together with information on the CDP

rules.condition: any contract type, total value excl. VAT above the relevant Threshold
rules.required_action: Procurement Legislation procedures; full competitive tender with at least five written tenders sought (where appropriate) via the Portal
rules.evidence_source: Procurement Portal tender record; procurement report
rules.verbatim_quote: Above Threshold [...] Procurement Legislation Procedures apply– full competitive tender process with at least five written tenders sought (where appropriate) via the Procurement portal.

rules.condition: any contract type, total value excl. VAT above the relevant Threshold
rules.required_action: advertise on the CDP
rules.evidence_source: CDP / Find a Tender notice
rules.verbatim_quote: Above Threshold [...] An advert should be placed on the CDP

rules.condition: contract excluded from competition under the Procurement Legislation
rules.required_action: prior written approval, plus board approval where applicable
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer; relevant board where applicable
rules.evidence_source: written Monitoring Officer approval dated before award
rules.verbatim_quote: The proposed contract is excluded under the Procurement Legislation. [...] Prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer is required and where applicable prior approval has been granted by the relevant board.

rules.condition: contract governed by the Provider Selection Regime (PSR)
rules.required_action: record key decisions and follow the PSR process
rules.evidence_source: PSR decision records
rules.verbatim_quote: Where the contract is governed by the Provider Selection Regime (PSR) [...] Key decisions must be recorded and the relevant process under PSR followed

rules.condition: award under a Purchasing Scheme without further competition
rules.required_action: prior written approval, plus board approval where applicable
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer; relevant board where applicable
rules.evidence_source: written Monitoring Officer approval dated before call-off
rules.verbatim_quote: The proposed contract is being awarded under a Purchasing Scheme (refer to 8 above) of a type where no further competition is being undertaken [...] Prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer is required

rules.condition: extension of an existing contract that provides for extension
rules.required_action: approval of the extension
rules.approver: S151 Officer
rules.evidence_source: S151 approval of the extension; contract extension clause

notes.note: 6.15 says Total Contract Value includes VAT; the Appendix B bands are stated 'exclusive of VAT'. The same contract can fall in different bands depending on which basis is used.
The Appendix C closing sentence tests 'annual or total value' against the Threshold, while 6.15 defines value as the total over the full potential duration.
Row A starts 'Above £1,000'; Appendix B sets no procedure for purchases of £1,000 or less.
For works, concession and light touch contracts, B2 ends 'less than £500,000' and C starts 'Above £500,000', so a value of exactly £500,000 falls in no band.

Appendix B rows B1 and C end 'less than the Threshold' and row D starts 'Above Threshold', so a value exactly at the Threshold has no procedure; Appendix A row 1 ('up to relevant Threshold') does include it.

Appendix A row 2 ends 'less than £500,000' and row 3 starts 'Above £500,000', so exactly £500,000 has no award authority; 4.3 ('over £500,000') agrees with row 3, while 7.4.2 ('up to £500,000') places £500,000 in the lower band for exceptions.
Row 4's band is '£2.5million or more' but its text says 'in excess of £2.5million'; a contract of exactly £2.5m is Executive-approved by the band and not by the text.
7.2.2 lets the Executive Director and/or Chief Executive waive competition at their discretion; 7.3 says only the Monitoring Officer and/or S.151 Officer may grant a waiver or exception.
7.4.2 does not parse ('consult with ... provided and an exception report has been approved') and its urgency route refers to 7.3, which says nothing about urgency (7.2.1 does).

Many clauses say 'the Threshold' or 'the relevant Threshold' without saying which of the three (works/concessions, goods/services, light touch); the applicable value depends on contract type, recorded as THRESHOLD_RELEVANT.
Advertising is 'must' for B1/B2 (£25,000 to below Threshold or £500,000) but only 'should' for the higher-value rows C and D.
5.2 refers to publishing every invitation to tender above £5,000, while Appendix B row A (above £1,000, below £25,000) mandates no advertising; how the two interact is not stated.
10.2 requires contracts 'as detailed in Appendix B' to be in writing, but Appendix B does not say which contracts must be in writing.
Unfilled placeholders: the document heading reads 'Part []' and Appendix A row 3 refers to 'Parts [] (Call-In) and [] (Forward Plan)'.
Footnote *** (the three thresholds) is defined, but no *** marker appears in the Appendix B table.
5.2 and 5.2.1 read as further items of the 5.1 Transparency Code list but are numbered as separate clauses.
6.23 is a heading ('Evaluations of Quotes and Tenders') numbered as a clause.
7.7 repeats 7.1 (exclusions are set out in Appendix C).
Row C does not parse ('no further competition is being undertaken a competition has already been undertaken') and ends with a stray '; or'.
Row E covers variations but asks for an 'extension report'; at exactly the Threshold neither 'below' nor 'greater than' applies.
7.5.2 names 'Service Director / Head of Service, Service Director or Executive Director', repeating Service Director.
